author: Claude Opus 5.5, same-session written analysis, not reviewed
summary: Rank-0/1 recipe has three steps: order of vanishing (have: Ota/Kato), auxiliary-independent shape (have: Theorem W), one global constant for all p (missing). Every known global object over Q gives first-derivative height formulas, which vanish in rank 2; nonzero rank-2 objects are p-adic, one prime at a time. Step C needs a second-derivative height formula over Q, the same ingredient Q36 needs.
